description: This Java source file defines an Android activity 'PhonePermissionRequestActivity' that manages runtime permission requests for external storage access, providing a user interface for permission rationale and handling user responses to proceed or deny permission requests.

classes.name: PhonePermissionRequestActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that provides a user interface to request and handle runtime permission for reading external storage, and communicates the user's decision to the main activity.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, checks for existing permission, and sets the content view.

methods.name: onClickApprovePermissionRequest
methods.description: Handles the approval button click, requests external storage permission.

methods.name: onClickDenyPermissionRequest
methods.description: Handles the denial button click, proceeds to start main activity without requesting permission.

methods.name: onRequestPermissionsResult
methods.description: Callback handling the result of permission request, proceeds to main activity.

methods.name: startMainActivity
methods.description: Starts the main activity, passing extra info if started by a service.
